statement.excerpt: Once the bill passes, as I hope it will, we will see, contra Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) and others in Silicon Valley, that life goes on — that innovation will continue just fine, that no major tech company actually leaves California, and that modest regulation that encourages companies to do the right thing is not fatal to the industry as they alleged.

our_interpretation: In context, passage means SB-1047 becoming law, not merely receiving legislative votes.
The forecast concerns industry outcomes under this specific law.
The ordinary reading predicts continued innovation, no major technology-company departure attributable to the law, and continued industry operation.
The speaker gives no deadline, innovation benchmark, or definition of a major company or departure.
criteria.support_condition: After SB-1047 becomes law, evidence shows continued innovation and industry operation without major technology-company departures attributable to the law.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After enactment, a major technology-company departure attributable to SB-1047, or credible evidence of severe innovation suppression or industry collapse caused by it, contradicts the relevant component.
